name: TraceShield Security Plugin
description: Runtime security gate for OpenClaw tool calls and trace events.

core_base_url.description: TraceShield Core or Mock Core base URL.

event_flush_timeout_ms.description: Async event flush timeout in milliseconds.

event_flush_interval_ms.description: Async event flush interval in milliseconds.

fallback_enabled.description: Enable conservative local fallback when Core is unavailable.

debug_full_payload.description: Allow full payload upload for local debugging only.

disk_queue_dir.description: Disk queue directory for async event retry.

memory_queue_max_events.description: Maximum number of events kept in memory before older entries are evicted.

local_allow_tool_kinds.description: Read-only tool kinds that may be locally allowed during fallback.

high_risk_tool_kinds.description: Tool kinds that fail closed when Core is unavailable.

coreBaseUrl.description: TraceShield Core or Mock Core base URL.
